sku_type.note: Literal concat, NOT trimmed: empty scent/packsize leave load-bearing double/trailing spaces (e.g. 'A2RCROS Sunscreen SPF50+ 30 gr  ', 'Expert Care Physical Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA ++++  Original 30 gr'). Verified 399/411 rows 2026-09-16; the ~12 exceptions are hand-written legacy rows.

keywords.note: TRIM(sku_type || ' ' || keywords_typo); when keywords_typo is empty this is just TRIM(sku_type). Verified 411/412 rows 2026-09-16.

_notes.identity_column: sku_type (dict). The QA table product_id_dict_qa uses sku_type_complete for the same string.
_notes.no_meta_column: babysunscreen_dict has NO _meta column - do not try to stamp it.

attribute_conventions.category: 'Baby & Kids Sunscreen' (359 rows; 'Baby & Kid Sunscreen' is a 23-row legacy typo)
attribute_conventions.sub_category: Lotion | Multi Variant | Spray | Stick | Cream | Cushion | Roll On
attribute_conventions.variant: Face & Body Lotion | Body Lotion | Face Lotion | Face Cream | Multi Variant | Stick
attribute_conventions.variant_group: Sun Protection | Sun Protection + Moisturizing | Multi Variant | Moisturizing | Calming
attribute_conventions.pack_type: Tube | Bottle | Multi Variant | Stick | Jar | Case | Roll On
attribute_conventions.banded: Single Pack | 2 Packs | 3 Packs | ... (item/unit count in the listing)
attribute_conventions.bundle_type: single | multipack ('multipack' only for N-of-the-same-SKU packs)
attribute_conventions.bundling_qty: FLOAT - number of items in the pack
attribute_conventions.bundle_quantity: FLOAT - N for an 'x N pcs' same-SKU multipack, else 1.0
attribute_conventions.scent / group_scent / fragrance_group: Original | Multi Variant (all three move together)
attribute_conventions.gramasi / total_gramasi: unit size as a bare number string; '' on Multi Variant packsizes; on A + B multi-item rows analysts put only the FIRST component's number
attribute_conventions.company: usually '' (empty string), only a few rows carry a real legal entity
